asiaMet_scientific_claims.claim: ASIAMET (1) — Registry: ASIAMET CO., LTD. (บริษัท เอเซียเมท จำกัด), commercial reg 0105530060373, is registered as a distributor/installer of telecommunications equipment, scientific instruments and meteorological instruments. Note: Thai directories list its address in Lat Krabang (105 Moo 4, Chalong Krung Rd), not Bang Rak; the Bang Rak/Silom address belongs to the later-converted Scientific Research Co., Ltd. The e-GP bidder rows confirm reg 0105530060373 is the firm that bid the TMD radar tenders.

ASIAMET (2) — OEM line = VAISALA (Finland). Primary scanned TMD announcement (OCR'd): TMD e-procurement no. 25/2552 for 'โครงการจัดหาเครื่องมือตรวจอากาศการบินที่ทางวิ่งที่ ๓ (สุวรรณภูมิ) ๑ ระบบ' (aviation weather observation system, Suvarnabhumi Runway 3); 3 envelopes submitted, only 2 passed technical: บริษัท เอเซียเมท จำกัด and บริษัท เอ็กเซล คอนซัลแตนท์ส จำกัด (Excel Consultants). Committee selected the VAISALA brand, product of VAISALA Oyj FINLAND, purchased from AsiaMet for 164,245,000 THB (0.50% under the 165M reference price), approved by the ICT Minister. ASIAMET (3) — TMD, 2555 (2012): AsiaMet won maintenance/repair contract สจ.5/2555 (9 Nov 2011) for the Doppler weather radar with interconnection equipment at Suvarnabhumi Airport, 5,778,000 THB, special (วิธีพิเศษ) method — its documented radar-adjacent win.

ASIAMET (4) — TMD, 2561 (2018): AsiaMet was one of 3 bidders on the Suvarnabhumi lightning Warning System (สข.69/2561): Genomatch won at 328,490,000 THB; Marwin bid 332,531,390; AsiaMet's price not printed in the TMD summary — a documented loss.

ASIAMET (5) — TMD, Apr 2567 (2024): AsiaMet won e-bidding 'ซื้อครุภัณฑ์วิทยาศาสตร์ เครื่องมือตรวจวัดอุตุนิยมวิทยาการบินเพื่อสนับสนุนการบริหารจัดการจราจรทางอากาศ (MET/ATM) ระยะที่ 1 ที่ท่าอากาศยานสุวรรณภูมิ 1 ระบบ' as lowest bidder at 623,810,000 THB (budget 635M); winner announced 10 Apr 2567, contract สข.117/2567 signed 26 Apr 2567. Isranews criticized the award as signed before the FY2567 Budget Act took effect ('จัดซื้อก่อนได้งบ') and noted the losing comparators were 'the same old group' of TMD vendors. This is TMD's aviation-weather program (Thailand's aviation meteorology sits under TMD's อุตุนิยมวิทยาการบิน bureau, not DoA).

ASIAMET (6) — TMD, 20 Jan 2569 (2026): primary e-GP winner announcement (pdftotext-verified) — AsiaMet again lowest bidder and winner of e-bidding EB.6/2569 'ปรับปรุงเครื่องมือตรวจอากาศการบิน ที่ท่าอากาศยานสุวรรณภูมิ 1 ระบบ' at 385,914,300 THB incl. VAT, 2.93% under budget; project ID 68099138830. Local copy: /Users/nat/.claude/projects/-Users-nat-dev-radar/c42fd9f0-a585-4edc-8948-0a5254a22e21/tool-results/webfetch-1789615322219-t9y4al.pdf

ASIAMET (7) — TMD FY2569 S-band radar tenders: AsiaMet BID weather radar to กรมอุตุนิยมวิทยา (TMD) and failed technical/qualification consideration despite being lowest bidder at both stations it entered: Chumphon (project 68099138543) 391,620,000 THB, result flag N; Phitsanulok (68099138724) 389,480,000 THB, result flag N. Winners: Genomatch (Chumphon 410,987,000) and Marwin (Phitsanulok 408,954,000). Fresh API snapshot: /Users/nat/dev/radar/data/egp_sband_procure_results_api_2026-09-17.json

ASIAMET (8) — The TMD FY2569 S-band TOR is brand-neutral (no OEM named anywhere; magnetron/klystron/solid-state all permitted; 2700–2900 MHz, 750 kW peak, ≥8 m antenna, HPBW ≤1.0°, PRF 250–2000 Hz, dual-pol; identical 446,166,666.66 THB reference price at all four stations). Which OEM AsiaMet offered in the rejected S-band bids is NOT publicly disclosed (no MAL/manufacturer authorization letter published); its documented OEM relationship is Vaisala for AWOS/aviation weather, so a Vaisala radar offer is plausible but unverified. ASIAMET (9) — กรมฝนหลวง (RRD): no record found of AsiaMet bidding or winning any RRD radar tender (RRD records show only Genomatch, Scientific Research and Marwin as radar counterparties 2560–2569). กรมการขนส่งทางอากาศ (DoA/DOT): no public e-GP radar tender record naming AsiaMet (or any bidder list) found; Thai aviation-weather procurement runs through TMD. The '~480M per station' figure in the public record is RRD's FY2570 budget request for 2 radars (Udon Thani + Phimai, 480M each, 960M total), per MP Chayaphol's censure-debate critique — not a DoA award.

SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH (1) — Registry: ห้างหุ้นส่วนจำกัด ไซแอนติฟิค รีเสิร์ช (Scientific Research Limited Partnership), reg 0103534016083, registered business: trading, importing, installing, repairing and maintaining hydrological and meteorological instruments. It later converted to บริษัท ไซแอนติฟิค รีเสิร์ช จำกัด (reg 0105569102638, 10M THB capital, Kamol Suko building, Silom Rd, Bang Rak, Bangkok) — the Bang Rak address in the task brief matches this entity; e-GP bidder rows for the FY2569 radar tenders still carry the LP registration 0103534016083.

SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH (2) — OEM line = EEC (Enterprise Electronics Corporation, USA) at กรมฝนหลวง (RRD): (a) Feb 2560 RRD monthly summary shows two EEC-brand rain-radar spare-parts lots — SR won lot 1 at 5,215,500 THB and Genomatch lot 2 at 5,050,000 THB (the two also competed against each other); (b) FY2564 report records 5 EEC-brand radar purchases at 498,850 THB by specific method; (c) 2562: RRD's mobile royal-rainmaking weather laboratories ยี่ห้อ EEC (Phrae, Songkhla, Chumphon) supplied by SR with 49,321,930-THB installments; (d) FY2568: EEC-fleet mobile radar spares (Singhanakhon station) 5,389,000 THB to SR. RRD's own fleet history confirms EEC DWSR-8500S S-band radars ran 2542–2556 before Gematronik METEOR 600S replaced them.

SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH (3) — Additional TMD product lines beyond radar: 1680 MHz automatic upper-air sounding systems, AWOS, Transmissometer Processing Units (1.5M, สข.22/2568), Radiometrics-brand short-wave upper-air/microwave-radiometer spares at RRD (3.886M + 7.568M in 2565), and a Smart Broadcast for Shipping system (28.58M). Aggregate TMD footprint per Isranews/govspending: 47+ projects worth 868.34M THB (2558–2566).

SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH (4) — Major TMD radar WINS: 2555 two dual-pol weather radars 300,941,000 THB (e-auction, สข.39/2555); 2559 mobile X-band dual-pol radar 48,792,000 THB (สข.78/2559 — an outlier bid 35% under the 75M median vs Genomatch 73.6M / Marwin 78.1M); 2561 dual-pol upgrades Phuket+Lamphun 86,670,000 (สข.71/2561); 2562 upgrades Rayong (43.17M), Chumphon (43.12M), Khao Khiao (59.39M), Wichian Buri (43.17M); 2567 new C-band dual-pol radar Sathing Phra, Songkhla 139,100,000 (สข.133/2567) and Khao Khiao C-band overhaul 57,988,500 (สข.145/2567); FY2569 Samut Songkhram radar O&M 19,800,000 (สจ.13/2569).

SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH (5) — PUBLIC BID FAILURES/REJECTIONS (a) FY2569 TMD S-band dual-pol radar e-biddings: SR submitted the LOWEST price at BOTH stations it entered — Bueng Kan (68099138641) 375,570,000 THB and Krabi (68099247067) 375,570,000 THB (identical price for both stations) — and received result flag N (did not pass qualification/technical consideration) at both; only Genomatch (winner) and Marwin passed. (b) Historical losses in the ~300M fixed-radar series to Marwin: 2557 Don Mueang+Khon Kaen (SR 309.99M vs winner 309.337M), 2558 Nan+Ubon (307.92M vs 306.9295M), 2559 Chiang Rai+Surat Thani (304.9M vs 302.568M), 2561 Suvarnabhumi S-band (308.7485M vs 304.95M) — bids consistently within 0.4–1.8% of the winner; 2556 S-band spares lost to Marwin (9.29M vs 9.2448M); 2557 radar spares lost to Genomatch (1.819M vs 1.6906M). (c) RRD 2567 selective-method radars Hat Yai (455.171M) and Sattahip (228M, both won by Genomatch): SR served only as a reference-price quotation source (21–22 Mar 2567), not selected. SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH (6) — RRD FY2570 '480M/station' quotation round: for the Udon Thani and Phimai replacement radars (480M budget each, 960M total), the three quotation sets are Genomatch 480.0M (exactly the budget; Genomatch's letter claims sole Thai distributorship of Leonardo/Gematronik), Scientific Research 486.3M (+1.31%) and Marwin 492.0M (+2.50%) — identical totals for BOTH sites with different scope mixes, all dated 19 June 2569, same day as RRD's own ปร.4/ปร.5 forms; construction portion 62,215,600 identical across provinces. Draft TOR tables for Phimai/Udon print 'ยี่ห้อ LEONARDO/Gematronik' in the spec table (850 kW requirement), while the EEC DWSR-class envelope offered through SR's channel also fits numerically. So SR is positioned in the 480M program as the EEC-channel quote, not (yet) a bidder — no e-bidding TOR has been published as of 15 Sep 2026.

SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH (7) — Investigative scrutiny (Isranews, Mar 2567): SR and Genomatch — the two recurring TMD radar/upper-air vendors — used the SAME auditor (นายไชยวุฒิ จิตธิวงษ์) since 2547 (Genomatch switched in 2564), and appear as reciprocal bid comparators ('คู่เทียบ') in the same tenders; SR+Genomatch combined exceed 2,400M THB of TMD contracts 2558–2566. Isranews presented the linkages without alleging an offense; neither company responded to requests for comment.

CROSS-CUTTING — FY2569 S-band outcome pattern: all four TMD station tenders (Chumphon, Bueng Kan, Phitsanulok, Krabi) had exactly 3 bidders from the same pool {Genomatch, Marwin, AsiaMet or Scientific Research}; the two incumbents (Genomatch/Marwin) passed and split the 1,647.8M THB in awards; the two lowest-priced challengers (AsiaMet at Chumphon/Phitsanulok, SR at Bueng Kan/Krabi) both failed technical/qualification with no published reason — the committee's failure reports are an explicit evidence gap. CONTEXT — vendor-OEM mapping from the repo dossier (multi-channel, none proven exclusive): Marwin Technologies → EEC; Genomatch → Leonardo/Gematronik METEOR line (also bought Gematronik spares at RRD); Scientific Research → EEC in RRD work; AsiaMet → Vaisala in TMD aviation weather. Both Leonardo METEOR 700S and EEC DWSR-8501S fit the TMD 750 kW TOR envelope, so the TOR itself did not hard-lock one OEM. Repo analysis: /Users/nat/dev/radar/CLAUDE.md
